title: RUN OVER CROWN AND MOMENTS
why: His #196 yes on 2026-10-28: keep the crown and add closest call and most damage to both two player run over cards. Actual health damage is counted by the authority, capped at health left, across guns, melee, frags, tripwires, barrels, elements and air strikes. Watch in playtest: hurt each player to different positive health, use different damage sources, then compare the crown and both new callouts in both windows after the score settles. Fatal and downed health must not win closest call; ties share credit. No save key, feel values or seeded draws change.
now: Two player run over shows crown, closest call and most damage alongside the existing moments.
